race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 3YOF 2nd Semi Final Pace
race.comment: QUATRO MOTH (5) led as a hot favourite first up and while she couldn't see it out she stuck on okay when beaten 1.7m into third. That was her first outing for 10 weeks so she should strip fitter. Give her another chance. SWEET IRISH LOCH (3) wasn't disgraced from a wider draw in the heats. Recorded a win and a placing from her previous two outings here and she is better served by tonight's draw. KEAYANG PASSION (7) chased a couple of smart fillies when placed first up. Draws wider but won her lone second-up attempt so is open to improvement. RACHELS LEGACY (6) is unbeaten when second-up so look for improvement on the resuming fifth from the back row. ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (12) is a first four hope with some luck from a tricky draw.
